method: Single fixed-shape body; independently articulated raster limbs; exact stance locks; no RIFE or image morphing
reference: Catavitello et al. 2015, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0133936, CC BY, DogS walking second stride contact timing
limitations: Short 2D articulated-cutout mechanics proof. Joint seams and stiff body/backpack remain possible; not a finished natural cartoon walk. No realtime visual playback/listening claim. Rig ground locks are exact; encoded/raster pixels can jitter slightly.
